python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
root = Path('frontend/src')
replacements = {
    'content/contentBlocks': 'content/contentBlockUtils',
    './contentBlocks': './contentBlockUtils',
}
changed = []
for path in root.rglob('*'):
    if path.suffix not in {'.ts', '.tsx'}:
        continue
    text = path.read_text()
    new = text
    for old, repl in replacements.items():
        new = new.replace(old, repl)
    if new != text:
        path.write_text(new)
        changed.append(path.as_posix())
print('updated_import_files=' + ','.join(changed))
PY
